name: GET /api/admin/speech/catalog/:entry_id/certification-runs - Every certification run of an entry (operator)
description: OPERATOR route (x-admin-ops-token). All runs of the entry across tenants and scopes, newest first. A catalog entry is certified only after its certification run passes the thresholds (c1171be1-c7ce-4c6d-acbc-98ffe825bc53#AC2): llm — tool-call accuracy, p95 time to first token, barge-in stop; stt — word error rate of phone-band (8 kHz) audio a reference TTS synthesised, and time to the final transcript; tts — time to first audio, real-time factor, intelligibility through a reference STT. Keys come from the tenant key vault; ProjexCloud holds none. An operator can no longer set certified by PATCH (409 CertificationRequiresRun). 200 { runs }. Errors: missing ops token 401.
